cases.title: New-resource isolation
cases.required_result: New repository/site/database/Identity/secrets have distinct verified IDs; denied targets never receive writes.

cases.title: Fresh database
cases.required_result: All migrations apply to empty new PostgreSQL; no old data/compiled code imported.

cases.title: Target collision
cases.required_result: Provisioner stops on wrong owner, old site ID, non-private repo or unrelated name collision.

cases.title: Source provenance
cases.required_result: Original workbooks remain byte-identical; imports carry source hash, cell and policy/version references.

cases.title: Three types and explicit selection
cases.required_result: Exactly PERSONAL/HOUSEHOLD/MERCHANT. The selected account persists across reload; no first-row fallback.

cases.title: Roles differ by account
cases.required_result: One actor can own A and view B; modifying path/body/client state cannot grant B write access.

cases.title: Capabilities and stale state
cases.required_result: Server denies/reasons/remediation agree with command policy; stale capability is not authorization.

cases.title: Invitations
cases.required_result: One-use intended-recipient acceptance; expired/revoked/other-recipient tokens fail; no unintended membership charge.

cases.title: Privacy across contexts
cases.required_result: Household access exposes no unrelated Personal/Merchant history, files, exports or totals.

cases.title: Independent adults
cases.required_result: Adult participants can keep private Personal account history and scoped Household allocations.

cases.title: Minor restrictions
cases.required_result: Guardian-funded participant cannot activate credit/Merchant or raise own limits through role/API edits.

cases.title: Revocation
cases.required_result: Accepted access can be revoked; the next protected read/write is denied; own-history retention follows explicit policy.

cases.title: One workflow
cases.required_result: Home/Cards/onboarding reach the same card-request route/component/command; no old/new choice or embedded legacy app.

cases.title: Saved prerequisites
cases.required_result: Draft account/holder/settings survive missing verification/funding, session renewal and reload.

cases.title: Issuance permission
cases.required_result: Spend alone cannot issue cards; manager alone cannot spend; responsible-party/product checks still apply to owner.

cases.title: Request uniqueness
cases.required_result: Concurrent same-request submits under same/different HTTP keys create one card and stable provider operation.

cases.title: Intent conflict
cases.required_result: Changed payload/version cannot replay a submitted request as a different card; return conflict.

cases.title: Distinct requests
cases.required_result: Two deliberate eligible requests can create two cards without creating extra backing/cap.

cases.title: Provider timeout
cases.required_result: Unknown remote outcome remains processing/reconciliation; no new provider operation ID on retry.

cases.title: Scoped funding
cases.required_result: Holder and backing assignment are authorized; arbitrary cross-account facility IDs fail.

cases.title: Freeze/replace
cases.required_result: Parent freeze cannot be undone on child card; replacement retains history and does not reset usage/cap.

cases.title: Format/controls
cases.required_result: Virtual/physical/single-use/merchant options use one form and supported policy; no real PAN/CVV is stored.

cases.title: Journal integrity
cases.required_result: Every posted entry balances by currency; direct update/delete is rejected; reversals are append-only.

cases.title: Exact values
cases.required_result: All money/rates use exact representations; overflow/malformed/currency mismatch inputs fail.

cases.title: Backing example
cases.required_result: $100 collateral + $10 settled purchase => $100 collateral, $10 obligation, $90 available.

cases.title: Concurrent auth
cases.required_result: Separate database clients/barrier: $80 and $30 cannot both approve against $100 shared backing.

cases.title: Payout versus pledge
cases.required_result: Concurrent commercial pledge/payout/refund cannot consume identical settled available funds twice.

cases.title: Limit composition
cases.required_result: Account/person/card constraints compose; limit edits preserve usage and new cards do not increase capacity.

cases.title: Holds and capture
cases.required_result: Approve/capture/partial capture/expire/reverse retain exact backed exposure; duplicates do not double subtract.

cases.title: Late events
cases.required_result: Genuine clearing after freeze/revocation is recorded/reconciled without granting new authorization.

cases.title: Repayment policies
cases.required_result: Consumer statement vs Merchant daily full repayment preserved; supervised funded users have no credit bill.

cases.title: Reconciliation
cases.required_result: Ledger, facility exposure, Merchant payable/reserves/payouts and reward liability reconcile to exact currency totals.

cases.title: One practice purchase
cases.required_result: Visible member action completes via durable provider events; no manual clear is required.

cases.title: Worker restart
cases.required_result: Crash after intent/event ack recovers without duplicate effects; Pending remains truthful.

cases.title: Replay/reordering
cases.required_result: Duplicate business/event IDs and out-of-order events are safe; invalid signatures fail.

cases.title: Narrow workers
cases.required_result: Only bounded mock event runner enabled; calendar schedules and real providers do not activate incidentally.

cases.title: Readiness
cases.required_result: Disabled/missing simulator/runner returns safe capability unavailability before promising usable purchase.

cases.title: One merchant hierarchy and payment domain
cases.required_result: Merchant owns MASTER; Personal and Household have explicitly accepted SUB relationships under one named master each. One merchant domain and exact provider binding per order; assignment/verification, liability and payment readiness remain separate. No anonymous P2P or automatic issuing authority.

cases.title: Guest checkout
cases.required_result: Guest pays without login/membership; receipt/status reveals no member/Household/operator data.

cases.title: Channel, order and document semantics
cases.required_result: One channel configuration supports SMS/text, email, invoice, bill, social, QR and web. One-time channels cannot create duplicate obligations across presentations/revisions; reusable channels create independent orders; partial invoices enforce atomic remaining amount. Receipt follows confirmed payment; delivery does not mean paid.

cases.title: Settlement and reserve
cases.required_result: Pending/reserved/disputed amounts unavailable; itemized provider fee and brand cost accounted separately.

cases.title: Refund
cases.required_result: Partial/full refund ceiling and proportional reward/fee reversal cannot be exceeded/repeated.

cases.title: Payout lifecycle
cases.required_result: Request reserves eligible backing; paid/failure/retry restores or settles once; permissions/step-up apply.

cases.title: Disputes
cases.required_result: Opened/resolved/chargeback events link original payment and preserve evidence/accounting.

cases.title: Scoped sub-MID delegation
cases.required_result: Household may delegate exact sub-MID/channel actions to accepted members or outside people without host-account membership or issuing visibility. Parent ceilings, live lineage, intended recipient, expiry and revocation enforced. Viewer/collector cannot refund, payout, reconfigure gateway or delegate without separate explicit authority.

cases.title: Pricing fixture
cases.required_result: Annual scenario equals Select $3200/Premier $2600/$600 saving; both base rates 0.50%.

cases.title: Shared bonus
cases.required_result: Spending/fee-only/mixed extras share one $300 membership-year cap across accounts/cards.

cases.title: Lifecycle rewards
cases.required_result: Monthly base, annual bonus, reversal, upgrade proration/no cap reset and earned credit without renewal.

cases.title: Cost imports
cases.required_result: Compute supplied Planning operating costs/contributions within $0.01 from source formulas; no residual plug.

cases.title: Cost completeness
cases.required_result: 60 enabled/25 missing Planning lines/58.3333% completeness; missing vs zero vs disabled retained.

cases.title: Basis and approvals
cases.required_result: Planning/Contracted/Actual never silently mix; locked approved versions unchanged; future rows off.

cases.title: Cases and privacy
cases.required_result: Customer opens case; operator assigns/escalates/resolves/reopens; internal notes and attachments stay scoped.

cases.title: Independent approval
cases.required_result: Requester cannot approve own protected action; payload edits/revocation invalidate approval.

cases.title: Partner separation
cases.required_result: Direct/referral/wholesale/embedded models keep customer/partner/platform economics and access separate.

cases.title: Partner API
cases.required_result: One-time scoped keys, revoke/expire, signed webhook retry/SSRF defense, reports and no cross-tenant access.

cases.title: New Identity
cases.required_result: Issuer/subject binding from new provider only; no email-only relinking/first-user admin/hosted demo bypass.

cases.title: Complete sign-in
cases.required_result: Signup/confirmation/login/expiry/reset/invite/logout work on actual hosted canonical origin.

cases.title: CSRF
cases.required_result: Valid external HTTPS origin reaches login validation; foreign/missing/null/spoofed forwarding origins fail.

cases.title: Session/MFA
cases.required_result: Secure/HttpOnly/host-only cookies where server-owned; logout/reset revoke; MFA/step-up and recovery replay limits.

cases.title: Secret isolation
cases.required_result: No provider tokens, keys, connection strings or callback tokens in browser bundle/cache/logs/screenshots.

cases.title: File controls
cases.required_result: Cross-account upload/read/export denied; allowed owner operation works; private Blob isolation across contexts.

cases.title: Clarity
cases.required_result: User completes card assignment, purchase and finds activity without old/new flow or internal provider vocabulary.

cases.title: Responsive accessible
cases.required_result: Desktop/mobile real browser; keyboard/dialog/focus/errors/contrast/zoom; no overflow at 320px.

cases.title: Error recovery
cases.required_result: Failed actions never show success; field values preserved; expired sessions/drafts resume safely.

cases.title: PWA privacy
cases.required_result: Installable public shell; never caches private APIs/account pages/documents or auth callbacks.

cases.title: Current dependencies
cases.required_result: Resolved versions/lockfile, real Next and Netlify builds; no guessed compatibility or fake stubs.

cases.title: CI exact revision
cases.required_result: Required suites execute (not skip) for reviewed SHA; detailed safe artifacts and release summary preserved.

cases.title: New deployment
cases.required_result: Ready actual new site/deploy ID/SHA/DB migrations observed; old projects unchanged.

cases.title: Preview isolation
cases.required_result: DB branch and auth/Blob/secret separation verified; protected previews do not mutate or expose main data.

cases.title: Hosted user journey
cases.required_result: Authorized new confirmed test account + card/funding/purchase + guest payment + reload/logout tested live.

cases.title: Public release review
cases.required_result: Owner approves public sandbox; Open registration with confirmation; mocks only; email caveat/operating costs disclosed.

cases.title: Restore and rollback
cases.required_result: Backup restore rehearsed in disposable new database; rollback preserves post-release financial events.
